title: Practice 5: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: I have breakfast at 7:30.
exercises.why: The following verbs belong to the "**Е**" type of conjugation: **думать** — **я думаю**, **ты думаешь** … **они думают**; **слушать**; **спрашивать**. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 16–18.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: В России ___ (писать) «Таллин», а в Эстонии по-русски пишут «Таллинн».
exercises.prompt: In Russia they write "Tallin", and in Estonia they write "Tallinn" in Russian.
exercises.why: The verbs **писать** and **жить** belong to the first "**Е**" type of conjugation, but do not follow exactly the pattern: **я пишу**, **ты пишешь** … **они пишут**; **я живу**, **ты живёшь** … **они живут**. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 16–18.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: The verbs **писать** and **жить** belong to the first "**Е**" type of conjugation, but do not follow exactly the pattern: **я пишу**, **ты пишешь** … **они пишут**; **я живу**, **ты живёшь** … **они живут**.

exercises.prompt: Do you think that everything that happens to us is predestined?
exercises.why: The letter **с** in the infinitive form **писать** is replaced by the letter **ш** in all forms of the present tense. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 16–18.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
